npcs.name: Employment Advisor
dialogue: Welcome to the Career Preparation Center!
Before starting a job, you need to learn how to act responsibly.
Visit the different areas, talk to the workers and complete their challenges.
You will face real-life situations and decide what people should and shouldn't do.
Make good decisions, earn points and get ready for your future job.
Good luck!
